class.name: FmodAudioBus
class.brief_description: Represents an audio bus for mixing with effects support.
class.description: FmodAudioBus represents an audio mixing bus in the FMOD audio system. Each bus has its own channel group for routing audio, and can have multiple audio effects applied to it. Buses are organized in a hierarchy managed by [FmodAudioBusLayout]. The master bus is the root of this hierarchy, with all other buses ultimately routing through it. Use buses to: - Organize audio into logical categories (Music, SFX, Dialogue, etc.) - Apply effects to groups of sounds - Control volume and routing for entire audio categories - Implement solo/mute functionality for mixing

method.name: init_bus
method.description: Initializes this bus with the specified [param name] and optional [param parent] channel group. This creates the internal FMOD channel group for audio routing.

method.name: set_parent
method.description: Sets the parent channel group that this bus outputs to.

method.name: get_bus
method.description: Returns the [FmodChannelGroup] used by this bus for audio routing. Returns [code]null[/code] if the bus has not been initialized.

method.name: get_parent
method.description: Returns the explicitly stored parent channel group. This cache may differ from native routing after a layout synchronization. Query the channel group's [method FmodChannelGroup.get_parent_group] for its current native parent.

method.name: get_bus_name
method.description: Returns the name of this audio bus.

method.name: release
method.description: Removes this bus's effects and clears its channel-group references. Releases the native channel group for buses other than [code]Master[/code].

method.name: add_effect
method.description: Inserts [param effect] into the stored effect list at [param index] and applies it to this bus. The list index is clamped between [code]0[/code] and [method get_effect_count]. It does not specify the FMOD DSP insertion position.

method.name: remove_effect
method.description: Removes the audio effect at the specified [param index] from this bus.

method.name: get_effect_count
method.description: Returns effect count.

method.name: get_effect
method.description: Returns the [FmodAudioEffect] at the specified [param index] in the effect chain. Returns [code]null[/code] if the index is out of bounds.

method.name: set_volume_db
method.description: Sets the volume of this bus in decibels. The default value is [code]0.0[/code] dB (unity gain).

method.name: get_volume_db
method.description: Returns the volume of this bus in decibels.

method.name: set_mute
method.description: Stores the user mute flag. Call [method apply_mute] to apply it, or use [method FmodAudioBusLayout.set_bus_mute] to update muting across the layout.

method.name: is_mute
method.description: Returns the stored user mute flag. A bus can also be muted by another bus's solo state.

method.name: apply_mute
method.description: Applies the stored mute flag and solo state to the channel group. The [param mute] argument means that any bus in the layout is soloed; this bus is muted when that argument is [code]true[/code] and its own solo flag is [code]false[/code].

method.name: set_solo
method.description: Stores the solo flag. Use [method FmodAudioBusLayout.set_bus_solo] to also recompute muting across the layout.

method.name: is_solo
method.description: Returns the stored solo flag, independently of the user mute flag. Use [method FmodAudioBusLayout.set_bus_solo] to apply solo muting across the layout.

method.name: set_bypass
method.description: Stores the bypass flag. Call [method sync_bypass] to apply it to the channel group's DSPs.

method.name: is_bypass
method.description: Returns the stored bypass flag. [method sync_bypass] applies this flag to the channel group's DSPs.

method.name: sync_bypass
method.description: Applies the stored bypass flag to every DSP currently in this bus's channel group.

members.member: Bus volume in decibels. A value of [code]0.0[/code] is unity gain.
